method: Read all three route templates, all four course content files and all sixteen published lesson bodies/frontmatters.
Read course hero, curriculum, full/compact signup wrappers and Vue clients, resource list, embed modal, shared player and course JSON-LD.
Followed source dependencies into signup action/helper, demo registry plugin/loader and installed Resend error-return contract.

Findings concern current reachable source; introduction by PR1355 was not established for every finding.

findings.title: Introduction demo button references an unregistered WebContainer demo

evidence.fact: embedConfig.src is oauth-pkce-intro, while import.localDir points to examples/oauth-pkce-app.
The action forwards embedConfig.src as the resource query parameter; imported files are not passed to the new window.
Registry IDs are example directory names; absent keys throw Demo not found.

findings.source_check: The only example directories are oauth-pkce-app and oauth-pkce-demo; no alias for oauth-pkce-intro exists in the inspected loader.
findings.impact: The advertised interactive demo cannot resolve its files through the production loader.
findings.recommendation: Use a registered key or an explicit validated alias, and add a source registry/reference contract check.
findings.verification_boundary: Deterministic source mismatch, not a browser reproduction; no WebContainer execution.

findings.title: Failed course signup can be recorded and displayed as successful
findings.affected_scope: Three signup-enabled course detail pages and their fifteen published lessons (Zitadel, GraphQL detail, Teleport).

evidence.fact: contacts.create response.error is never checked; session flag and analytics are written, and the handler falls through to success:true when response.data is null.
Installed SDK contacts.create returns the request result; unsuccessful HTTP responses resolve to {data:null,error:...} instead of throwing.
Any result.data moves the client into submitted success state.

findings.impact: A rejected provider request can show Thank you, persist a false subscription state and record activation despite no subscription being created.
findings.recommendation: Require a successful provider result before session/analytics/success writes; handle explicit returned errors for course and sponsor writes. Review contact.unsubscribed in the subscription check and duplicate handling before claiming subscribed.
findings.verification_boundary: Control-flow and installed-SDK inspection only; no provider call, form submission or session mutation. Teleport uses slug-like audience IDs, but their validity was not externally verified.

findings.title: Published Astro auth example redirects to a different route than the provided callback

evidence.fact: The OAuth client sends http://localhost:4321/auth/callback, but the instructed endpoint is pages/api/auth/callback.ts.
The tutorial says Arctic is the only dependency, but the example also imports @oslojs/jwt and oidc-client-ts.
The code example nests a button inside an anchor; this is invalid interactive composition in the learner's resulting app, not a live nested control on the lesson page.

findings.impact: Following the supplied instructions cannot deliver the promised working callback without correcting the route and setup omissions.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile callback path and dependency setup; use a single link styled as a control. Validate the complete tutorial against a pinned minimal example before marking it usable.
findings.verification_boundary: Internal source contradictions only; no authentication, installs or tutorial execution. Library-version compatibility and security completeness remain unaudited.

findings.title: Prerendered lessons cannot honor current subscription state
findings.affected_scope: All nine published Zitadel lessons and all six Teleport lessons.

evidence.fact: The route is prerendered and calls CourseSignupForm without server:defer or deferSubscriptionCheck.
The default is deferSubscriptionCheck=false; user and subscription status are evaluated at prerender time.
Client refresh happens only when deferSubscriptionCheck is true and the subscription prop is undefined.

findings.impact: Returning subscribers and signed-in readers receive the generic email form on each lesson instead of their current state. Repeated full signup sections add avoidable friction.
findings.recommendation: Use request-time state or a deferred client check with an undefined initial state; keep a compact updates entry point rather than repeating explanatory signup copy on every lesson.
findings.verification_boundary: Static data-flow proof; authenticated rendering and actual account state were not exercised.

findings.title: Course structured data invents duration and includes unpublished curriculum as available instruction

evidence.fact: Every module receives PT30M and total duration is module count times thirty; all modules become courseInstances and teaches entries.
Visible duration correctly requires measured published durations, but JSON-LD receives allCourseModules, including drafts.

findings.impact: Zitadel emits 10h30m for 21 modules despite only nine published and no recorded durations; Rust emits 30m, Teleport 3h and GraphQL 0m without source duration data. Hidden claims contradict the truthful visible contract.
findings.recommendation: Share a published-only projection; omit unknown durations and do not represent drafts as available instances.
findings.verification_boundary: Computed directly from source counts, not a rendered JSON-LD inspection.

findings.title: Early Zitadel lesson content repeats course sales copy and duplicates page structure

evidence.fact: Two consecutive paragraphs repeat the same course pitch.
Generic course welcome plus two overlapping summaries rather than a prerequisite checklist.
The same welcome heading and repeated summary are used for a distinct installation lesson.
Authored H1 duplicates the route H1; Overview repeats the description verbatim; the actual video follows the entire outcome outline.
The wrapper already supplies the module title and description before rendering authored content.

findings.impact: Readers and heading-navigation users encounter duplicate page titles and promises before the actual lesson. These are source-level redundancies independent of visual styling.
findings.recommendation: Remove redundant H1/intro copy; keep one short lesson-specific context and the actual teaching material. Do not invent missing step-by-step content.

findings.title: Teleport promises runnable demo scripts without supplying course-specific script links
findings.affected_scope: Teleport course detail and all six published Teleport lessons.

evidence.fact: Every video is promised to include runnable local Kind demo scripts.
The same script promise is repeated in the introduction.
The teaching steps explicitly refer to walking through demo scripts.

findings.source_check: All six lesson bodies/frontmatters and course resources were read. Resources link to upstream documentation/GitHub, not the demonstrated scripts. No Teleport examples directory is present.
findings.impact: The page does not provide the promised follow-along artifacts; prose checklists alone do not supply the referenced values/manifests.
findings.recommendation: Link the actual public demo repository/files, or narrow the promise to video walkthroughs. Do not label upstream product source as the lesson demo.
findings.verification_boundary: Page/source artifact availability only; scripts may be mentioned inside video content, which was not viewed.

findings.title: Catalog does not distinguish an empty announced course from available courses

evidence.fact: All courses are listed; secondary cards show only difficulty and Course, without published-lesson availability.
The description promises a comprehensive course and the body repeats a second learning-outcome list.
Only after opening the course does the curriculum explain that no lessons have been added.

findings.source_check: GraphQL has zero module files; Rust has one published module, Zitadel nine and Teleport six.
findings.recommendation: Expose availability before navigation, such as Announced / 0 lessons available; keep the honest empty state and updates option. Merge overlapping objective lists rather than adding filler.

findings.title: Zitadel curriculum and lesson headers use incompatible lesson numbering

evidence.fact: Curriculum display indices count every module, including draft Remix at position eight.
Lesson headers count only published modules.

findings.impact: Curriculum lesson 09 opens as Lesson 8 of 9, and lesson 10 as Lesson 9 of 9. Draft-skipping navigation is correct; the unexplained index change is not.
findings.recommendation: Use one stable lesson number or explicitly label the header as published-lesson progress.

findings.title: MDX retains a parallel legacy video layout and unused demo-file processing

evidence.fact: MDX imports VideoPlayer and wraps it in legacy className utilities instead of the shared frontmatter video layout.
Same duplicate video composition.
Same duplicate video composition.
Same duplicate video composition.
The route reads imports from process.cwd()/content/courses, a directory absent under the website cwd; errors return the original resource.
The active WebContainer action uses only course and resource ID, not the files processed by the route.

findings.recommendation: Move authored video metadata into the common lesson contract. Remove or consolidate unused local-file loading only after validating the actual demo registry path. Do not add a utility shim.
findings.verification_boundary: Structural duplication and absent path confirmed; no rendered claim about which legacy classes currently affect layout.

findings.title: Course catalog retains dead pre-migration CSS

evidence.fact: The style block defines courses-page* selectors; markup uses Academy recipe classes and none of these selector names.

findings.recommendation: Remove the orphan style block in a separately authorized cleanup. It provides no intentional current section styling.

shared_dispositions.reason: Single title, actual author identities and image, availability counts and one curriculum anchor have distinct purposes. No invented duration when missing.
Semantic ordered curriculum, explicit unavailable rows without dead links, section availability and real durations are useful; numbering must agree with lesson context.
Categorized resources, explicit external-window/dialog labels, URL validation and deduplication at the route are meaningful. No empty category chrome is emitted.
Authored info/tip/warning callouts distinguish actionable caveats; warning is normalized to caution and decorative SVGs are hidden. Computed colors/layout were not inspected.
Opt-in consent, labeled email, disabled pre-hydration form and status/error regions are justified; repeated long promotional framing and stale lesson subscription state are not.

Breadcrumbs, lesson context, draft-skipping previous/next, article and resources each support learning. Resources follow the article in DOM order. Desktop rail positioning and mobile reading order require rendered verification.

routes.disposition: Keep one featured course and compact secondary catalog. Availability is useful metadata; generic Course labels add less value. Remove dead CSS.
Keep explicit 9/21 availability and unlinked drafts. Reconcile numbering and machine-readable claims; broad course promises should not imply drafts are available.
Rework as an announced course with honest zero-lesson status before entry; keep useful references and updates, merge duplicate outcome lists.

Keep authored motivation and practical caveats; no empty supplementary sidebar is emitted. Pun-only objectives would benefit from concrete skill descriptions. The open-a-PR link actually targets issues/new and should be relabeled.

Keep the distinct audit/recording/joining explanations and concise course conclusion; no recording playback or external system was accessed.

additional_followups.note: Success/subscribed headings use h4 beneath the wrapper h2. Consider consistent heading hierarchy or non-heading status text; not a blocking functional defect.
Astro integration lesson provides only video.id, so thumbnailUrl falls back to an empty string. No rendered poster behavior was inspected.
Video islands are client-only without an authored SSR fallback. Captions are requested by the player, but media/caption availability and keyboard playback were not verified.

Shared lesson video explicitly receives isAuthenticated=false, and authored players omit it. Saving course watch position is consequently disabled; confirm product intent before treating this as a regression.
Provider-specific instructions and historical feature-preview language need a separate current-documentation audit. No external technical claims were verified in this source-only assignment.

limitations: No browser attempts in this source-review phase; no screenshots or rendered-page evidence.
No desktop, mobile or dark-theme signoff. Typography, spacing, imagery, code readability, sticky behavior, focus indication and actual overflow remain unverified.
